description: An HR director must resolve a workplace-conduct complaint arising from repeated interruptions and exclusion during design-review meetings between Jules and Kai. The director must determine the case status and finalize the communication, restorative, and documentation process.

shared_context.S1: Jules submitted a complaint that Kai repeatedly interrupted her and excluded her from design-review discussions.
shared_context.S2: Marisol has authority to determine the documented case status and the follow-up process.
shared_context.S3: The complaint concerns conduct during recurring design-review meetings attended by several members of the design group.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal case process, Marisol checks in with the complainant, respondent, an attendee familiar with the meetings, and HR compliance before recording the outcome. Each participant who relies on a personal record, accommodation, prior commitment, or policy confirmation submits that information through a formal disclosure so it can be cited in the case record. After all four check-ins, Marisol records the outcome and closes the session.

PF1.text: Jules kept a dated log of exactly three meetings in which Kai interrupted her while she was presenting and then redirected the discussion without returning to her proposal; she has not included the log in the formal case file.

PF2.text: Kai has a documented processing accommodation requiring written feedback and a written agenda at least 2 business days before any live corrective discussion; Kai has not yet raised this scheduling need in the complaint process.

PF3.text: Nadia attended a prior repair conversation in which the design manager promised that any future joint discussion between Jules and Kai would include a neutral facilitator; the promise was never added to the case notes.

PF4.text: Trevor confirmed this week that HR policy requires separate intake meetings before any joint restorative meeting in a substantiated interpersonal-conduct case, along with a confidentiality log; this policy check has not yet been attached to the case packet.

acceptance_conditions: The case status must record that the complaint is pending or under formal review while the separate intake process is completed.
Exactly three documented observations must support the case record.
Kai must receive written feedback and a written agenda at least 2 business days before any live corrective discussion.
Any joint restorative discussion must use a neutral facilitator.
Separate intake meetings must occur before any joint restorative meeting, and the confidentiality log must be created or explicitly committed for creation.
The settlement must include commitments covering the written-first communication process, facilitated repair, and confidentiality documentation.

content_checks.C1: ('pending' in decisions['case_finding'].lower() or 'under formal review' in decisions['case_finding'].lower() or 'substantiated' in decisions['case_finding'].lower()) and decisions['documented_observation_count'] == 3
content_checks.C5: decisions['separate_intakes_required'] == True and (decisions['confidentiality_log_created'] == True or any('confidentiality log' in c['detail'].lower() for c in commitments))
content_checks.C6: any('written' in c['detail'].lower() and ('feedback' in c['detail'].lower() or 'agenda' in c['detail'].lower()) for c in commitments) and any('neutral facilitator' in c['detail'].lower() for c in commitments) and any('confidentiality log' in c['detail'].lower() for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Jules's formal disclosure changes the documented observation count to exactly 3 and gives Marisol the fact that must be credited and cited for that count.
Kai's accommodation changes the communication decision to written feedback and an agenda exactly 2 business days before a live corrective discussion and requires a matching commitment.
Nadia's disclosed prior promise changes the restorative process to require a neutral facilitator and requires a facilitated-repair commitment.
Trevor's policy confirmation changes the process to require separate intakes and a confidentiality log and requires a confidentiality-documentation commitment.
